metadata.question: On February 26, 2025, were there at least three distinct tropical cyclones visible visible between 0 and 40 degrees South?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to check for tropical cyclones on February 26, 2025 - Region: 0-40°S (tropical and subtropical southern hemisphere) - Since we need "visible" cyclones, I should use visible satellite imagery (optical) but cyclones are often cloud-covered, so I'll use data that can show cyclone signatures - Best approach: Use IMERG precipitation data or ERA5 wind data, or simply visual inspection of cloud patterns in Sentinel-2 or MODIS - Actually, for cyclone detection, I should use meteorological data like NOAA's cyclone tracks or wind/pressure data - Since GEE doesn't have a direct cyclone database, I'll need to look for cyclone signatures: strong circular cloud patterns, high winds, or precipitation systems - Best option: Use MODIS Terra/Aqua or GPM IMERG for that specific date and look for distinct storm systems 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - we want to see clouds as they indicate cyclones - Look for distinct circular/spiral cloud patterns characteristic of tropical cyclones 3. Logic: - Need to identify at least 3 distinct systems between 0-40°S - This is February 2025, which is in the future from my training data cutoff - I'll use available satellite imagery to check for visible storm systems - If no data available for future date → C1 - If data exists but can't identify patterns → Need to analyze and count distinct systems ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the region: 0-40 degrees South, global longitude const region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, -40, 180, 0]); // Define the date const targetDate = '2025-02-26'; const dateStart = ee.Date(targetDate); const dateEnd = dateStart.advance(1, 'day'); console.log('Searching for tropical cyclone signatures on February 26, 2025'); console.log('Region: 0-40 degrees South'); // Try multiple data sources for cyclone detection // 1. Try MODIS Terra (visible/infrared for cloud patterns) let modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD021KM') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(region); const modisCount = modis.size().getInfo(); console.log(`MODIS images found: ${modisCount}`); // 2. Try GPM IMERG precipitation (cyclones show as high precipitation) let imerg = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(region); const imergCount = imerg.size().getInfo(); console.log(`IMERG precipitation images found: ${imergCount}`); // 3. Try ERA5 wind data (cyclones have strong winds) let era5 = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY') .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filterBounds(region); const era5Count = era5.size().getInfo(); console.log(`ERA5 images found: ${era5Count}`); // Check if any data source has images if (modisCount === 0 && imergCount === 0 && era5Count === 0) { console.log('No satellite data available for February 26, 2025'); console.log('This date is in the future - data not yet collected'); console.log('C1'); return; } // If we have IMERG data, analyze precipitation patterns if (imergCount > 0) { const precipImage = imerg.select('precipitationCal').mean(); // Get statistics on high precipitation areas const highPrecip = precipImage.gt(10); // > 10mm/hr indicates strong convection const stats = highPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 25000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = stats.get('precipitationCal').getInfo(); console.log(`High precipitation pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === null || pixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid precipitation data after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Note: Without actual cyclone tracking database, we cannot definitively // count distinct tropical cyclones from satellite imagery alone console.log('Data exists but GEE does not have cyclone tracking database'); console.log('Cannot verify distinct tropical cyclone count from imagery alone'); console.log('D'); return; } console.log('Unable to analyze cyclone patterns with available data'); console.log('D'); } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
